prism-core.reason: Charm Hyper's Prism Core is an 8B routing model that sends coding tasks to fast, economical models only, without the top-tier roster used by full Prism (per There's An AI For That); it picks a model per request, so it is a router, not one fixed model.

prism-flash.reason: Charm Hyper's Prism Flash is the fast, low-cost tier of its Prism routing line, which picks a model per coding request from a roster (Prism Core is documented as the same product over the economical roster); a router, not one fixed model.
